title: Glowing Grate Apparitions
description: A dark wooden grate with glowing yellow orbs arranged in a grid pattern, emitting light and faint particle trails. Above the grate, several blurry, ethereal blue-violet spectral figures with glowing yellow cores hover in the darkness.
prompt: Dark atmospheric scene showing a heavy wooden grate viewed from above with multiple bright yellow glowing orbs arranged in a grid, each orb emitting soft light rings and yellow particle trails. Above the grate float several blurry, translucent spectral figures in shades of deep blue and violet with bright yellow glowing centers, rendered in loose expressive brushstrokes against a pitch black background.
